purpose: Fresh unseen English input and transfer testing when true-exam memory residue reduces diagnostic value.

pools.notes: Use as high-quality unseen academic reading and transfer material. Normal successful use may be read → answer → done; expand only when evidence requires repair.
Use selectively for fresh reading exposure when it serves comprehension, discourse, or transfer goals.

Add high-quality periodical articles incrementally. Articles do not need questions when pure comprehension/discourse transfer is the real learning objective. Prefer learner value and freshness over corpus size.

unseen_policy.principle: Unseen material is limited diagnostic capital.
unseen_policy.rule: Do not reveal passage-specific answers, analysis, or decisive evidence before the first clean attempt when an item is held as unseen.
unseen_policy.memory_residue_rule: Once exam or external material carries substantial memory residue, use it for repair/exam-mechanics practice rather than treating its accuracy as clean unseen evidence.

selection_rule: Prefer the next text that best tests the learner's current reading bottleneck while remaining genuinely fresh. Do not consume unseen material merely to complete a fixed quota.
projection_rule: Astro should project the same core clean-attempt and progressive-disclosure interaction semantics across exam and external reading, while allowing questionless periodical objects to use read → optional compression/repair flows.
